minutes.headline: School Committee approved two grant/line transfers, the superintendent's FY23 goals and operating protocols; capital plan timing set.
minutes.summary: The committee approved a Turkey Hill line-item transfer, surplus book declaration, a mentor facilitator posting under Title IIA, several superintendent goals, a $12,040 ESSER transfer and revised operating protocols. It discussed bus release consent, transportation policy, school committee goals, and the capital plan timeline, including a failed Turkey Hill fire alarm. A resident criticised communication.

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved a transfer within the SR2 grant, moving money from non-instructional support salaries to grant fringe benefits.
The committee approved the superintendent's student learning goal and continued the climate goal and the K-5 professional practice goal for 2022-2023.
The committee accepted its revised operating protocols.
The committee approved a transfer within Turkey Hill's budget for touch view displays, declared surplus materials for bid, and approved posting a Title IIA-funded mentor facilitator.
The bus release consent issue was sent to two school advisory councils with a legal opinion to be sought; the capital plan gets a first look on September 21.

why_it_matters: The superintendent said programs paid for by ESSER grant money will have to end or be replaced by other grants when it runs out, and that the town is not expected to cover the difference, so grant-funded staff and programs are a possible future budget question.
The capital plan and the bus release consent policy are both still open, so residents may be asked to weigh in on building and transportation decisions before any vote.
watch_next: September 21 meeting: first look at the capital plan, with a short public forum before any vote.
Next meeting: review and approval of the strategy for continuous improvement action plans.
